provenance.creation: Released HTTP server; four Memory writes. evolved-atomic also ran 1.1.0, 1.2.0, official 1.3.0 Atomic apply/verify, then three Atomic writes. No manual schema edits.

schema: CREATE INDEX ix_pc_artifact_tags_family_key ON pc_artifact_tags (scope_id, family, tag_key_hash, target_type, artifact_id, target_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_artifact_tags_key ON pc_artifact_tags (scope_id, tag_key_hash, family, target_type, artifact_id, target_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_decision_observations_operation ON pc_decision_observations (scope_id, operation_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_decision_observations_scope_created ON pc_decision_observations (scope_id, created_at, observation_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_dream_dispatch ON pc_dream_runs (scope_id, operation, status, request_generation)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_dream_list ON pc_dream_runs (scope_id, accepted_at, run_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_processing_intent_binding_sequence ON pc_artifact_processing_intents (binding_name, pending_sequence)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_recurrence_observation_key ON pc_recurrence_observation (scope_id, signature_key_hash)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_recurrence_observation_outcome ON pc_recurrence_observation (scope_id, task_outcome_source_type, task_outcome_source_id, task_outcome_position)
CREATE INDEX ix_pc_recurrence_observation_revision ON pc_recurrence_observation (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision)

CREATE TABLE pc_access_audit (
	cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(128), 
	transport VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	principal_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	principal_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	principal_description TEXT, 
	actor_type VARCHAR(16), 
	actor_id VARCHAR(255), 
	actor_description TEXT, 
	action VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resource_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	deployment_id VARCHAR(128), 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256), 
	family VARCHAR(128), 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	selector_type VARCHAR(32), 
	selector_entry_id VARCHAR(128), 
	allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	policy_revision VARCHAR(64), 
	matched_subject_type VARCHAR(16), 
	matched_subject_id VARCHAR(255), 
	matched_subject_description TEXT, 
	binding_id VARCHAR(64), 
	target_type VARCHAR(16), 
	target_id VARCHAR(255), 
	target_description TEXT, 
	role VARCHAR(32), 
	expected_version INTEGER, 
	result_version INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (cursor), 
	UNIQUE (event_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_access_idempotency (
	actor_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	payload_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	result_binding_id VARCHAR(64), 
	secondary_binding_id VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (actor_id, idempotency_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_access_idempotency_actor_key UNIQUE (actor_id, idempotency_key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_access_owners (
	owner_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	object_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(128), 
	target_artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	selector_type VARCHAR(32), 
	selector_entry_id VARCHAR(128), 
	owner_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	owner_description TEXT, 
	established_at VARCHAR(32), 
	policy_revision VARCHAR(64), 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (owner_kind, object_key_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_access_owners_kind CHECK ((owner_kind = 'artifact' AND artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND candidate_id IS NULL AND target_artifact_id IS NULL AND established_at IS NOT NULL AND policy_revision IS NOT NULL) OR (owner_kind = 'candidate' AND candidate_id IS NOT NULL AND artifact_id IS NULL AND selector_type IS NULL AND selector_entry_id IS NULL AND established_at IS NULL AND policy_revision IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_access_relationship_heads (
	name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (name), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_access_relationship_heads_revision_nonnegative CHECK (revision >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_access_relationships (
	binding_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	subject_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	subject_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	subject_description TEXT, 
	resource_key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	resource_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	deployment_id VARCHAR(128), 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256), 
	family VARCHAR(128), 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	selector_type VARCHAR(32), 
	selector_entry_id VARCHAR(128), 
	role VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	singleton_key VARCHAR(64), 
	granted_by_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	granted_by_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	granted_by_description TEXT, 
	reason TEXT, 
	created_at VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	expires_at VARCHAR(32), 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	policy_revision VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	revoked_at VARCHAR(32), 
	revoked_by_type VARCHAR(16), 
	revoked_by_id VARCHAR(255), 
	revoked_by_description TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (binding_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_access_relationships_version_positive CHECK (version > 0), 
	UNIQUE (singleton_key)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_agent_skill_targets (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	display_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	agent_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	installation_scope VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	delivery_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	installation_id VARCHAR(128), 
	state VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	enrollment_token_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	enrollment_expires_at DATETIME, 
	credential_subject VARCHAR(128), 
	credential_verifier VARCHAR(64), 
	receiver_version VARCHAR(64), 
	environment_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	machine_hostname VARCHAR(255), 
	workspace_name VARCHAR(128), 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, target_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_agent_skill_targets_installation UNIQUE (scope_id, agent_kind, installation_scope, installation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_agent_skill_targets_enrollment_token UNIQUE (enrollment_token_digest), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_agent_skill_targets_credential_subject UNIQUE (credential_subject), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_agent_skill_targets_credential_verifier UNIQUE (credential_verifier), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_agent_kind CHECK (agent_kind IN ('codex', 'claude_code')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_installation_scope CHECK (installation_scope IN ('project')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_delivery_mode CHECK (delivery_mode = 'agent_pull'), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_state CHECK (state IN ('pending', 'active', 'revoked')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_state_payload CHECK ((state = 'pending' AND enrollment_token_digest IS NOT NULL AND enrollment_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND installation_id IS NULL AND credential_subject IS NULL AND credential_verifier IS NULL) OR (state = 'active' AND enrollment_token_digest IS NULL AND enrollment_expires_at IS NULL AND installation_id IS NOT NULL AND credential_subject IS NOT NULL AND credential_verifier IS NOT NULL) OR (state = 'revoked' AND enrollment_token_digest IS NULL AND enrollment_expires_at IS NULL AND credential_verifier IS NULL)), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_agent_skill_targets_generation_nonnegative CHECK (generation >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_candidate_heads (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	result_family VARCHAR(128), 
	result_artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	result_revision INTEGER, 
	decision_reason TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, candidate_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, candidate_id, version) REFERENCES pc_artifact_candidate_versions (scope_id, candidate_id, version) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, result_family, result_artifact_id, result_revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_candidate_heads_status CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_candidate_heads_terminal_result CHECK ((status = 'approved' AND result_family IS NOT NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND result_revision > 0 AND decision_reason IS NULL) OR (status = 'rejected' AND result_family IS NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NULL AND result_revision IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NOT NULL) OR (status = 'pending' AND result_family IS NULL AND result_artifact_id IS NULL AND result_revision IS NULL AND decision_reason IS NULL))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_candidate_versions (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	proposal BLOB NOT NULL, 
	source_refs BLOB NOT NULL, 
	artifact_refs BLOB NOT NULL, 
	target_family VARCHAR(128), 
	target_artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	target_revision INTEGER, 
	reason TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, candidate_id, version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, target_family, target_artifact_id, target_revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_candidate_versions_version_positive CHECK (version > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_candidate_versions_target_complete CHECK ((target_family IS NULL AND target_artifact_id IS NULL AND target_revision IS NULL) OR (target_family IS NOT NULL AND target_artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND target_revision > 0))
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pc_artifact_fts USING fts5(
    scope_id UNINDEXED,
    family UNINDEXED,
    artifact_id UNINDEXED,
    revision UNINDEXED,
    searchable_text,
    tokenize='unicode61'
)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_artifact_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pc_artifact_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_artifact_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_artifact_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_artifact_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_heads (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	searchable_text TEXT, 
	lifecycle_state VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL, 
	replacement_artifact_id VARCHAR(128), 
	governance_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, merged_into_id VARCHAR(128) NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_heads_revision_positive CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_heads_lifecycle_state CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('active', 'deprecated', 'retired')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_heads_governance_generation_nonnegative CHECK (governance_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_heads_replacement_deprecated CHECK (replacement_artifact_id IS NULL OR lifecycle_state = 'deprecated')
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_lineage_artifacts (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	upstream_family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	upstream_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	upstream_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, is_merge_input BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, upstream_family, upstream_artifact_id, upstream_revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_lineage_sources (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision, ordinal), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, source_type, source_id) REFERENCES pc_sources (scope_id, source_type, source_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_auto_wave_targets (
	wave_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_through BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (wave_id, binding_name, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_auto_wave_target_source_positive CHECK (source_through >= 1)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_binding_states (
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	last_auto_wave_completed_at DATETIME, 
	last_schedule_checkpoint_at DATETIME, 
	scan_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	scan_in_progress BOOLEAN DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	scan_upper_pending_sequence BIGINT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (binding_name), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_scan_generation CHECK (scan_generation >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_intents (
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	pending_sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	dirty_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	clean_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	requested_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	handled_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	last_auto_scan_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (binding_name, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_intent_sequence CHECK (pending_sequence > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_intent_dirty CHECK (clean_generation >= 0 AND clean_generation <= dirty_generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_intent_request CHECK (handled_generation >= 0 AND handled_generation <= requested_generation), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_intent_scan CHECK (last_auto_scan_generation >= 0), 
	UNIQUE (pending_sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_leases (
	supervisor_group VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	holder_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	supervisor_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	lease_expires_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (supervisor_group), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_leases_generation_positive CHECK (supervisor_generation > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_migration_receipts (
	migration_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_snapshot BLOB NOT NULL, 
	requested_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	dirty_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	source_through BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (migration_id, binding_name, scope_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_pending (
	binding_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_through BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	flush_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	handled_flush_generation BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (binding_name, scope_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_pending_source_positive CHECK (source_through >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_pending_flush_nonnegative CHECK (flush_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_pending_handled_nonnegative CHECK (handled_flush_generation >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_processing_pending_handled_not_ahead CHECK (handled_flush_generation <= flush_generation)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_schema (
	singleton INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_version INTEGER DEFAULT '1490' NOT NULL, 
	phase VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	migration_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	config_manifest TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (singleton), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_schema_singleton CHECK (singleton = 1)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_processing_sequences (
	singleton INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	sequence BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (singleton), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_processing_sequence CHECK (singleton = 1 AND sequence >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifact_publications (
	target_scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	target_family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	target_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	target_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	source_family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (target_scope_id, target_family, target_artifact_id, target_revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_scope_id, target_family, target_artifact_id, target_revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_scope_id, source_family, source_artifact_id, source_revision) REFERENCES pc_artifacts (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_artifact_publications_request UNIQUE (target_scope_id, idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE "pc_artifact_tags" (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	target_type VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	tag_key_hash BLOB NOT NULL, 
	tag_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	tag VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	assigned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, target_type, target_id, tag_key_hash), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id, family, artifact_id) REFERENCES pc_artifact_heads (scope_id, family, artifact_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_artifact_tags_target CHECK ((target_type = 'artifact' AND target_id = artifact_id) OR (target_type = 'memory_entry' AND family = 'memory'))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_artifacts (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_atomic_memory_current (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	state_version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	projection_format VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	searchable_text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tag_keys TEXT NOT NULL, 
	embedding BLOB, 
	profile_fingerprint VARCHAR(64), 
	embedding_input_hash VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, artifact_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_revision CHECK (revision > 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_state_version CHECK (state_version >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_atomic_memory_current_embedding_metadata CHECK ((embedding IS NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NULL) OR (embedding IS NOT NULL AND profile_fingerprint IS NOT NULL AND embedding_input_hash IS NOT NULL))
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pc_atomic_memory_current_fts USING fts5(scope_id UNINDEXED, artifact_id UNINDEXED, revision UNINDEXED, state_version UNINDEXED, content_hash UNINDEXED, projection_format UNINDEXED, kind UNINDEXED, text UNINDEXED, searchable_text, tag_keys UNINDEXED, identity_token, tokenize='unicode61')
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5, c6, c7, c8, c9, c10)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_atomic_memory_current_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pc_connector_checkpoints (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	binding_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	connector_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	connector_version VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	checkpoint BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, binding_id)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_decision_observations (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	observation_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	operation_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	consumer VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	policy_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	privacy_boundary VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	coverage VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	verdict VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	assessment_source VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	final_action VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	used_fallback BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	fallback_reason VARCHAR(128), 
	provider_id VARCHAR(128), 
	backend_model_id VARCHAR(256), 
	model_policy_id VARCHAR(256), 
	requests BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens BIGINT, 
	output_tokens BIGINT, 
	latency_ms FLOAT, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, observation_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_decision_observations_requests_nonnegative CHECK (requests >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_decision_observations_input_tokens_nonnegative CHECK (input_tokens IS NULL OR input_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_decision_observations_output_tokens_nonnegative CHECK (output_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_decision_observations_latency_nonnegative CHECK (latency_ms IS NULL OR latency_ms >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_dream_runs (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	principal_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	request_digest VARCHAR(71) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	generation INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_generation BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	payload BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, run_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(scope_id) REFERENCES pc_scopes (scope_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_dream_idempotency UNIQUE (scope_id, principal_key, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_dream_generation CHECK (generation >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_external_skill_registrations (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	external_skill_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	agent_kind VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	host_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	installation_scope VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	locator VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	locator_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(2000) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, external_skill_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_external_skill_registrations_binding UNIQUE (scope_id, provider, host_id, installation_scope, locator_hash), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_pc_external_skill_registrations_scope CHECK (installation_scope IN ('user', 'project', 'plugin'))
)

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_artifact_archive (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content BLOB NOT NULL, 
	memory_citations BLOB, 
	metadata BLOB NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, family, artifact_id, revision)
)

CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE pc_memory_entry_fts USING fts5(
    scope_id UNINDEXED,
    memory_artifact_id UNINDEXED,
    head_revision UNINDEXED,
    entry_id UNINDEXED,
    entry_version_id UNINDEXED,
    searchable_text,
    tokenize='unicode61'
)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_memory_entry_fts_config'(k PRIMARY KEY, v) WITHOUT ROWID
CREATE TABLE 'pc_memory_entry_fts_content'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, c5)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_memory_entry_fts_data'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, block BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_memory_entry_fts_docsize'(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sz BLOB)
CREATE TABLE 'pc_memory_entry_fts_idx'(segid, term, pgno, PRIMARY KEY(segid, term)) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE pc_memory_entry_heads (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	family VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	memory_artifact_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	head_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entry_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	entry_version_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	entry_content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
